alwaysShown.question: dv105_abduction_risk
alwaysShown.why: Item 8 is asked whatever was answered about travel or records.

alwaysShown.question: dv105_custody_orders
alwaysShown.why: Item 9 opens the custody section and does not depend on anything above it.

alwaysShown.question: dv105_children_lived_together_five_years
alwaysShown.why: Item 4a opens its own section. It follows the children block only because that block is the last thing item 3 asks, and it is asked however many children there are.

alwaysShown.question: dv105_child_home_1_lived_with
alwaysShown.why: Every row of the table asks who the children lived with, including the rows that follow the confidential-address box. That box is about the current address only.

alwaysShown.question: dv105_supervised_location
alwaysShown.why: Item 12b is asked of everyone in item 12. It follows "have they agreed to supervise?" only because that is the last thing 12a asks of a nonprofessional supervisor.

alwaysShown.question: dv105_unsupervised_location
alwaysShown.why: Item 13b, the same: it follows the last question of 13a and does not depend on it.

alwaysShown.question: dv105_child_home_2_asked
alwaysShown.why: Whether there is an earlier address does not depend on whether the current one is confidential. It follows that box only because the box is the last thing the first row asks.
